items.title: Laxman Utekar, Rajkumar Periasamy and Vishnuvardhan Set New Films With Bhushan Kumar’s T-Series (EXCLUSIVE)
items.title_zh: Laxman Utekar、Rajkumar Periasamy和Vishnuvardhan与Bhushan Kumar的T-Series合作推出新片（独家）
items.summary: Directors Laxman Utekar, Rajkumar Periasamy and Vishnuvardhan are set to collaborate with Indian studio T-Series chair and managing director Bhushan Kumar on three new films. Title, story, cast and production details have not been disclosed yet.
items.summary_zh: 导演Laxman Utekar、Rajkumar Periasamy和Vishnuvardhan将与印度影视公司T-Series董事长兼总经理Bhushan Kumar合作拍摄三部新电影。片名、剧情、演员阵容和制作细节尚未披露。

items.title: SpaceX shares jump on alternative trading platform after Musk says he will expand share donations
items.title_zh: 在马斯克表示将增加股票捐赠后，SpaceX的股票在另类交易平台上飙升
items.summary: SpaceX shares jumped in overnight trading on Blue Ocean ATS after Elon Musk said on X that he would donate shares to American children every year.
items.summary_zh: 埃隆·马斯克在X上表示，他每年都会向美国儿童捐赠股份，此后，SpaceX的股票在Blue Ocean ATS的夜盘交易中飙升。

items.title: Two Italians killed in Kuwait drone attack; Trump says Iran war ends ‘whenever I want it’
items.title_zh: 科威特无人机袭击造成两名意大利人死亡；特朗普称“只要我想”，伊朗战争就会结束
items.summary: Iran's foreign minister Abbas Araghchi said "The incident is suspicious and looks like a precooked recipe for war."
items.summary_zh: 伊朗外交部长阿巴斯·阿拉格齐表示：“这起事件令人起疑，看起来像是为战争预先炮制的阴谋。”

items.title: China industrial profits growth surges to a 5-month high of 20.1% in October
items.title_zh: 10月份中国工业利润增长率飙升至20.1%，创5个月新高
items.summary: China's economy has been running at two speeds, with AI-related manufacturing and exports powering growth while household consumption has been lagging.
items.summary_zh: 中国经济一直以两种速度运行，与人工智能相关的制造业和出口推动了经济增长，而家庭消费则一直滞后。

items.title: ‘Blade Runner 2099’ Boss Silka Luisa on What the Finale Means for Replicants and the Fate of Cora and Olwen
items.title_zh: 《银翼杀手2099》主创西尔卡·路易莎（Silka Luisa）谈论大结局对仿生人的意义以及科拉（Cora）和奥尔文（Olwen）的命运
items.summary: SPOILER ALERT: This article contains major spoilers for the finale of “Blade Runner 2099,” now streaming on Prime Video. In the finale of “Blade Runner 2099,” the future of humanity is anything but certain.
items.summary_zh: 剧透警告：本文包含《银翼杀手2099》大结局的重大剧透，该剧现已在Prime Video上线。在《银翼杀手2099》的大结局中，人类的未来绝非板上钉钉。

items.title: Netflix’s coziest show has made a very quiet return
items.title_zh: Netflix最温馨的节目悄然回归
items.summary: The bigger Netflix gets, the easier it is to miss stuff. This is true of all digital platforms, of course, but it's especially true of Netflix of late, as the streaming service's lineup now also includes a growing library of reality shows, live-programming, and even games.
items.summary_zh: Netflix 规模越大，就越容易错过一些内容。当然，所有数字平台都是如此，但最近Netflix尤其如此，因为该流媒体服务的节目阵容现在还包括不断扩大的真人秀、直播节目甚至游戏的库。

items.title: Nvidia hits pause on chip shipments to Southeast Asia
items.title_zh: 英伟达暂停向东南亚出货芯片
items.summary: Nvidia has told manufacturing partners to pause server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia as the U.S. tightens its push to keep AI chips out of China.
items.summary_zh: 英伟达已告知制造合作伙伴暂停向马来西亚、新加坡、泰国和印度尼西亚出货服务器，因为美国正在加紧努力，阻止人工智能芯片进入中国。

items.title: Is Alice Huang a spy or not?
items.summary: The central, still-unproven claim in the Nvidia scandal is that Alice Huang, the former Megaspeed exec with whom Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang had an extramarital affair, is a Chinese spy.
items.summary_zh: Nvidia丑闻的核心、尚未得到证实的说法是，Nvidia首席执行官黄仁勋曾与其有婚外情的Megaspeed前高管黄仁勋（Alice Huang）是一名中国间谍。

items.title: ‘Not really the thing to take a victory lap in’: the meaning of Jensen Huang’s new jacket
items.title_zh: “这不是值得庆祝的事情”：黄仁勋新夹克的寓意

items.summary_zh: 英伟达的掌门人以一身新装回归。但是，从皮衣换成棉衣，这对于权力和领导力来说意味着什么？• 您的收件箱中没有收到《时尚宣言》吗？请在此处订阅。对股市和穿皮夹克的人群来说，上周意义重大。
